messages:
ana (PM): quick sync — customer asked for an "escrow + export" appendix they can sign off on. want a short escalation matrix and what artifacts we provide.

mike (Eng-Sec): reality: hot failover for customer keys ~5m typical, full tenant export times vary (10-90m). manual escrow takes ops approval and can be hours.

sasha (Legal): we should offer only service credits (tiered) as remedies. add clear exclusions: legal holds, customer key compromise, third-party KMS outage. cap credits per incident and annually.

devin (AE): customer's compliance team wants a right-to-evidence clause and sample export manifest in the appendix. they may push for faster windows — offer a paid priority lane.

tina (CS): auditors look for signed manifests: export_id, tenant, timestamp, object list, checksums, operator id, approvals. plus a runbook to produce those artifacts within 5 business days.

rob (SRE): product items to map: 1) failover health checks + SLO dashboard, 2) resumable export pipeline with resumable chunks, 3) signed manifest generator + chain-of-custody logging, 4) opt-in escrow workflow with approvals.

opsbot: Deploy notice: export-streamer v3 rolled out in eu-west-1 at 2025-10-15T09:12:00Z :white_check_mark:

mike (Eng-Sec): sample credit tiers proposal: minor miss (<4h) = 0.5% MRR, major (4-24h) = 1% MRR, critical (>24h) = 2% MRR. per-incident cap 10%, annual cap 50%.

sasha (Legal): I'll draft a short appendix template with the matrix + exclusions + escalation path. prefer credits only, not cash penalties.

devin (AE): I'll collect the three most aggressive asks so we can prepare negotiation notes.

tina (CS): I'll pull two recent audit requests to validate the manifest fields we need to generate.

ana (ana (PM)): actions: eng estimate failover tests + manifest tooling (1-2w), eng prototype resumable export (3-5w), legal produce appendix draft (this Thu), cs gather customer asks (EOD). meeting Fri 10am to review. :thumbsup:
